title: Google Project Suncatcher
style: cinematic semi-realistic digital painting, deep midnight navy and teal shadows with warm amber-gold sunlight highlights, volumetric light rays, subtle film grain, high detail, soft bloom, clean composition with empty negative space in the lower third

scenes.image_prompt: a sleek refrigerator-sized satellite with large golden solar wings floating in low Earth orbit, the curved blue Earth below, the sun flaring brightly on the horizon behind it, a faint glow of computer circuitry visible through a small window on the satellite body
scenes.vo: Google just launched A.I. chips into orbit.

scenes.image_prompt: extreme close-up inside an open satellite body: four glowing AI processor chips on a dark circuit board, warm amber light pulsing along the traces, Earth's blue curve softly reflected on the metal casing
scenes.main: *4 TPU chips* inside a fridge-sized satellite
scenes.sub: Built with Planet  ·  running Google's Gemini
scenes.vo: It's called Project Suncatcher: a fridge-sized satellite carrying four Google TPU chips.

scenes.image_prompt: a Falcon 9 style rocket lifting off at dawn from a coastal launch pad, huge plume of glowing exhaust and billowing clouds, ocean and palm silhouettes, rocket shown from a low heroic angle, unbranded
scenes.vo: It rode to space this week, on a SpaceX Falcon 9.

scenes.image_prompt: a satellite gliding along the day-night terminator of Earth in a sun-synchronous orbit, its golden solar panels bathed in constant sunlight while the planet below is half in night with city lights, the sun as a bright star
scenes.main: In the right orbit the *sun never sets*
scenes.sub: Nonstop solar power, almost no batteries
scenes.vo: Why space? In the right orbit, the sun never sets. That means nonstop solar power.

scenes.image_prompt: a satellite in the vacuum of space with its chips overheating: large radiator panels glowing deep orange-red with heat shimmer, dark empty space around it, tension and danger, the cold blue Earth far below
scenes.main: There's *no air* to cool the chips
scenes.vo: The catch? There's no air up there to cool the chips, so the A.I. runs in short, fifteen-minute bursts.

scenes.image_prompt: a futuristic tight cluster of dozens of satellites flying in formation above Earth, connected to each other by thin glowing amber laser beams, forming a giant orbital data center grid, epic wide view
scenes.sub: 2 more test satellites planned next year
scenes.vo: The dream: huge clusters of satellites, linked together by lasers.

scenes.image_prompt: a race in orbit: several different futuristic satellites and a large spacecraft streaking across space above Earth, each leaving light trails, sense of competition and speed, dramatic sun flare
scenes.main: The *space AI race* is officially on
scenes.sub: SpaceX and Starcloud are building it too
scenes.vo: And Google isn't alone. SpaceX and Starcloud are racing to build this too.

scenes.image_prompt: a lone astronaut silhouette standing on a lunar ridge looking up at a glowing ring of orbital data-center satellites encircling the distant Earth, hopeful and awe-inspiring, wide cinematic
scenes.main: Not cheaper soon. But the future is *up there*
scenes.sub: Would you trust AI running in space?
scenes.vo: It won't be cheaper any time soon. But the future of A.I. might be up there. Would you trust it?
